svg.title: How Wander TV works
svg.desc: Phones and the remote drive the Fire TV app over the home Wi-Fi. Page text crosses to AWS only when someone presses Make it cards or submits a quest. AWS side: API Gateway HTTP API, Lambda (Python), Amazon Bedrock with Guardrails, DynamoDB, Amazon Polly, CloudWatch.
svg.text: Phones and the remote drive the browser over your Wi-Fi. The cloud sees a page only when someone asks.
Scan the QR on the TV: a web page
Fire OS · Kotlin · plain Android Views
Zero-dependency HTTP + WebSocket on a plain socket.
Serves the phone page, seats up to 4 players.
AiClient · HTTPS · 4-10 s timeouts, then on-device fallback
PRIVACY BOUNDARY Page text crosses only when you press Make it cards or submit a quest
Trims page text, asks the model, then checks
the evidence quote really is on the page.
No backend or no network? Cards, quest checks and Lumo's lines fall back on-device.
